Class PostHocCliodynamicMetricsExtractor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.PostHocCliodynamicMetricsExtractor
public final class PostHocCliodynamicMetricsExtractor extends Object

Post-Hoc Cliodynamic Metrics Extractor

Decouples physical simulation execution from cliodynamic academic evaluation.
Evaluates macro-historical and cliodynamic indicators (Seshat complexity, EROEI, Turchin structural-demographic stress, Marchetti fossil shares, ORBIS speeds) strictly a posteriori from saved physical snapshots, eliminating all heavy telemetry computation from the headless simulation loop.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
